summary: Clearway Energy filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval and implementation of an amended charter that converted all Class A common stock into Class C common stock, eliminating the Class A class. Simultaneously, Clearway Energy Group deposited 41,678,637 Class B shares into a voting trust to maintain proportional voting power post-conversion. The board recommended the charter amendment; no advisors named. The mechanics involve a class conversion and voting trust structure to preserve control dynamics. Watch for any subsequent shareholder litigation or regulatory scrutiny regarding voting power concentration.
